cfg.engine: Active container engine used across Studio ('docker' by default, or 'podman').
cfg.language: Interface language for Docker and Podman Studio ('auto' follows VS Code display language).
cfg.composeCommandStyle: How Compose commands are executed: 'auto' ('docker compose' for Docker, 'podman-compose' / 'podman compose' for Podman), 'plugin', 'standalone', or 'custom'.
cfg.composePath: Optional custom Compose executable path (leave empty for automatic engine defaults).
cfg.inPod: Pod grouping behavior (--in-pod) when running podman-compose in Podman mode.
cfg.machineName: Default Podman Machine VM name (Windows/macOS in Podman mode).
cfg.pollingInterval: Container status polling interval in milliseconds.
cfg.logBufferSize: Maximum number of log lines kept in memory.
cfg.autoDetectFiles: Automatically detect docker-compose.yml, compose.yml, and podman-compose.yml files in workspace and active containers.
cfg.confirmDeletions: Ask for confirmation before destructive delete or prune actions.
cfg.logsOutput: Default target for container logs ('studio', 'outputChannel', or 'terminal').
cfg.enablePushCommand: Enable Push Image actions in the Images page.
cfg.pushDefaultRegistry: Default target registry prefix when pushing images (e.g., docker.io/my-user or quay.io/my-org).
cfg.registryProvider: Container registry provider (Docker Hub, Quay.io, GHCR, ACR, ECR, or Custom).
cfg.registryAuthType: Registry authentication method ('engineCli' uses docker/podman login session).
cfg.registryUsername: Username for private OCI registry authentication.
cfg.registryAutoLogin: Automatically run docker login / podman login when saving registry credentials.
